faq_heading: Homes near Fleetwood Park Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Fleetwood Park Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Fleetwood Park Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Fleetwood Park Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Fleetwood Park Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 275 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,435,000, townhomes $780,000, condos $551,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Fleetwood Park Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Fleetwood Park Secondary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 275 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Fleetwood Park Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Coyote Creek Elementary (0.4 km north), Walnut Road Elementary (1.3 km north-east) and William Watson Elementary (1.7 km east).

Fleetwood Park Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7940 156 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Fleetwood Park Secondary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Fleetwood Park Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Fleetwood Park Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Fleetwood Park Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 275 homes sold within 2 km of Fleetwood Park Secondary: 83 houses, 139 townhomes and 52 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $780,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Fleetwood Park Secondary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Fleetwood Park Secondary in a straight line (14 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is Coyote Creek Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Berkshire Park Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Holy Cross Regional High School (2.1 km); the nearest independent school is Cornerstone Montessori School (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (1.8 km). Other secondary schools close by: Holy Cross Regional High School (2.1 km north-east), Enver Creek Secondary (2.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Holy Cross Regional High School, 2.1 km north-east of Fleetwood Park Secondary.
